Gem Smashers.name: Gem Smashers
Gem Smashers.summary: Many ages ago. The Earth was populated by beings that lived in peace and harmony until a fearsome scientist named IMBU and his henchmen arrived to steal earth's energy, capture all the inhabitants and lock them up in crystal cells. Miraculously, three creatures escaped: BAU, BAM and BOM. They became Gem Smashers, traveling the world to spring, spin, and smash the crystal cells where their friends are imprisoned. It's up to you to help our little heroes survive!

Mameshiba.name: Mameshiba
Mameshiba.summary: A 3DS game featuring the character Mameshiba.

Myst.name: Myst
Myst.summary: This version of Myst is an expanded version of the original Nintendo DS release.

Pilotwings Resort.name: Pilotwings Resort
Pilotwings Resort.summary: Pilotwings Resort, an aerial adventure featuring airplanes, hang gliders and rocket belts. Players soar above tropical Wuhu Island in 3D as they complete missions or snap pictures.

Pro Evolution Soccer 2012 3D.name: Pro Evolution Soccer 2012 3D
Pro Evolution Soccer 2012 3D.summary: Pro Evolution Soccer 2012 3D for Nintendo 3DS is a portable football simulation game featuring full 3D visuals and motion-controlled camera angles. It offers licensed teams, various gameplay modes including Master League and Champions League, and supports local multiplayer. The game emphasizes realistic animations and strategic play. It builds on the core mechanics of the PES series, adapted for handheld gaming.
